title: Morning rush in Burlington: every bus, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Burlington, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus inside the city on an average November weekday.

Burlington Transit has no October timetable, so I used November 2 to 27 for it and October 2026 for the other agencies. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Burlington city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Frequent, Regular and GO, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 57 buses at 7:48 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in the other timetables and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
